## Teaching points

1. This patient is systemically well, drinking and has no CT complication.
2. Selective antibiotic use is reasonable in uncomplicated disease; do not penalize a defensible local treatment choice.
3. Outpatient care requires clear deterioration advice and accessible reassessment.
